record.question: A clayey soil has a maximum dry density of 16kN/m3 and optimum moisture content of 12%. A contractor during the construction of core of an earth dam obtained the dry density 15.2kN/m3 and water content 11%. This construction is acceptable because
options: The density is less than the maximum dry density and water content is on dry side of optimum.
The compaction density is very low and water content is less than 12%
The compaction is done on the dry side of the optimum
Both the dry density and water content of the compacted soil are within the desirable limits
